title: Cricket & Antoinette
description: Cricket and Antoinette represent two separate worlds, the world of noise, chaos and creativity, and the world of work, order and discipline; as they fall in love, in spite of obvious differences, they manage to create harmony.

title: Happily N'Ever After 2: Snow White: Another Bite at the Apple
description: Snow White (Helen Niedwick) must prevent her father from marrying a scheming witch who wants to rule the kingdom.

title: My Sweet Monster
description: Princess Barbara is secretly in love with Prince Edward. When the sneaky post clerk Weasel demands the king to marry him to Barbara, she flees. Sweet monster Bogey does everything in his might to help Barbara save the kingdom.

title: Wickensburg
description: When a mother and her young son move to a small town, they soon discover the town harbors a dark secret.

title: Return to Wickensburg
description: Mr. Hexenmeister has escaped from prison, and once again threatens Wickensburg. A race against time to find an ancient orb, capable of destroying the entire town, before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: Vamps
description: Bloodsucking party girls find their destinies at stake when one falls for the son of a vampire hunter and the other encounters a long-ago love.

title: Pups United
description: A group of talking dogs team up to save the Youth World Cup soccer finals.

title: Children on Their Birthdays
description: A 13-year-old (Joe Pichler) develops his first crush while his mother begins a romance with a wholesome mechanic.

title: Face the Music
description: Lisa (Molly Ringwald) and Charlie Hunter (Patrick Dempsey) are an award-winning songwriting team -- that is, until the demise of their marriage ends their musical partnership. With divorce proceedings underway and Charlie already attached to a hot young girlfriend, it doesn't seem like they'll have a change of heart anytime soon. But, when a French movie producer makes them a lucrative offer to write a love song, they're forced to collaborate -- and bicker -- once more.

title: H Is for Happiness
description: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
description: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire.

title: A Brilliant Young Mind
description: Struggling to build relationships with others, a teenage math prodigy (Asa Butterfield) develops a budding friendship with a young girl (Jo Yang) while competing at the International Mathematics Olympiad.

title: Miss Julie
description: A baron's frustrated daughter (Jessica Chastain) courts scandal and more when she tries to seduce her father's valet (Colin Farrell).

title: Measure of a Man
description: A teen develops a bond with a Wall Street executive while learning to stand up to bullies during one life-changing summer.

title: Bernie the Dolphin
description: A brother and sister befriend a badly sunburned dolphin that has been separated from its family, uncovering a secret plan that could destroy the beach and their new friend's home.

title: Bernie the Dolphin 2
description: The kids are thrilled that Bernie has come back. But so has their old enemy Winston, who's about to kidnap the talented dolphin. Kevin and Holly must rescue their splashy friend before it's too late.

title: Sea Level
description: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
description: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
description: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

title: Turtle Tale
description: Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.
